note: Curated filter list for the product selector. Deliberately NOT derived from whatever tags appear in the data: an auto-populated selector grew to 26 checkboxes and buried the ones administrators actually use. Adding a tag to the taxonomy no longer adds a checkbox; it must be listed here.
